newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ s/adj unemployment rises to 6.7 pct at June 30.
newsitem.headline: NZ s/adj unemployment rises to 6.7 pct at June 30.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand on Tuesday issued the following provisional, seasonally-adjusted data for June quarter employment and unemployment.
Figures are based on standard international definitions with "revised from" figures in brackets.

Note - expectations were for an unemployment rate of 6.92 percent, a 0.15 percent contraction in quarterly employment growth, an annual employment growth rate of 0.05 percent and a participation rate of 65.65 percent.
